name: Kotia Enterprises Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1980, Kotia Enterprises Ltd trades goods and renders services related to civil and construction works[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company provides construction and civil work solutions. It executes turnkey projects, does marketing of pumps, Motors, Switchgears and other allied engineering goods, servicing and dealing in their spare parts and to manufacture or get manufactured, process, design, assembled, repair or other wise deal in all kind of submersible-Pumps and other types of Pumps of any variety or description. Company also entered into trading of Bleached Hardwood Kraft Pulp and is looking for expansion of business operations in this segment

pros: Stock is trading at 0.59 times its book value
Market value of investments Rs.29.8 Cr. is more than the Market Cap Rs.22.1 Cr.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -61.4% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -0.72% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 365 days.
